points.description: Names at least three valid parameters affecting MRR in ultrasonic machining, from: frequency of vibration, amplitude of vibration, abrasive slurry concentration, abrasive particle (grit) diameter/size. Any wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if one or two valid parameters are given (or three given but only about one is clearly valid).

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for three valid parameters from the model answer list (frequency, amplitude, slurry concentration, particle diameter), in any wording; naming two valid ones is also generous enough for most credit, but give 1 if only one or two are right. Give 1 mark for one or two valid parameters. Give 0 if none are valid. Extra wrong items do not cost marks.
